images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, Integrated Research Facility
images.why: Caption identifies colourised electron microscopy of purified HPV particles from cell-culture supernatant. Magenta particles provide strong colour and flexible near-square cropping. URL requests 3000 px width; native dimensions and download access were not verified.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, NIH
images.why: Caption confirms orange SARS-CoV-2 particles isolated from a patient, imaged by TEM and colour-enhanced at NIAID IRF. Strong subject contrast. Flickr 1024 px rendition; larger download and direct-file access were not verified.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, NIH
images.why: Caption confirms a colour-enhanced TEM of SARS-CoV-2 particles isolated from a patient. Useful particle-focused alternative. Flickr 1024 px rendition; larger download and direct-file access were not verified.

images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, NIH
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies patient-isolated SARS-CoV-2 particles in a colour-enhanced TEM captured at NIAID IRF. Flickr 1024 px rendition; larger download and direct-file access were not verified.

images.author: NIAID Rocky Mountain Laboratories, NIH
images.why: Caption identifies orange SARS-CoV-2 virions emerging from grey cultured cells, isolated from a US patient. Colourised SEM with strong contrast and cellular context. Flickr 1024 px rendition; larger download and direct-file access were not verified.

images.author: Maria Teresa Catanese and Charles M. Rice, The Rockefeller University; colourisation by NIAID
images.why: Caption specifically confirms a colourised TEM of a hepatitis C virion. A single purple particle provides a clear focal subject for a near-square card. Flickr 1024 px rendition; larger download and direct-file access were not verified.
